title: Script
features:
⚡ Speedster Roleplay Script Information ⚡



This script creates a simple GUI controller for the Roblox game Speedster Roleplay. It allows the player to modify speed, teleport to NPC enemies, and enable automatic attacks.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 Features Included

🚀 Speed Changer
• Allows you to set your character speed manually.
• You can type any number up to 9999.
• If you enter a number higher than 9999, the script will automatically limit it to 9999.

🌀 Teleport to Thug
• Instantly teleports your character to the nearest NPC thug in the game.
• The teleport places you a few studs away from the NPC so you can attack immediately.

⚔️ Auto Attack (Toggle)
• Automatically attacks enemies using the game's attack remote.
• When enabled, it repeatedly performs the M1 attack every 0.2 seconds.
• The button changes between ON and OFF.

📊 Status System
• Displays messages such as:

- Speed successfully applied
- Teleport success
- Errors or invalid input

🖥️ Draggable GUI
• The interface can be moved anywhere on the screen.
• Clean dark theme with rounded UI design.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 How To Execute

1. Copy the script.
2. Open your Roblox executor.
3. Join the game Speedster Roleplay on Roblox.
4. Paste the script into your executor.
5. Click Execute.
6. The GUI will appear on your screen automatically.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 Controls

Apply Speed
Enter a number in the speed box and press Apply Speed.

Teleport to Thug
Press Teleport to Thug to instantly move near the closest NPC enemy.

Auto Attack
Press the Auto Attack button to toggle automatic attacks.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⚡ Script Loaded Message
When the script runs successfully, the console will display:

"Final Controller Loaded Successfully"

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

This script is designed for convenience and faster gameplay inside Speedster Roleplay.
